name: Eligible Counterpart CSD Creation Request V 01
definition: The EligibleCounterpartCSDCreationRequest message is sent by an instructing party to the executing party to request for the creation of an eligible counterpart CSD in the executing system collateral management reference data.||Usage: |It aims at instructing the creation of a new eligible counterpart CSD with corresponding details.|Processing and confirmation of the eligible counterpart CSD creation request message are provided via a collateral management status advice.
